lead: A stack of sections that expand and collapse. Expanding, keyboard navigation and the aria wiring come from Base UI's Accordion.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `divided` draws a line between items, `bordered` an outer frame, `filled` a light card per item.

multiple.title: Multiple
multiple.description: With `multiple`, several items can be open at once.

default-open.title: Default Open
default-open.description: `defaultValue` lists the items open at first; use `value` / `onValueChange` to control them.

demo.a1: Install the package, import a theme style, and render a component.
demo.q2: Can I switch the design language?
demo.a2: Yes: set data-theme-style on the html element and nothing else changes.
demo.a3: Behaviour and aria come from Base UI.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `accordion.css`; the height animation uses `data-starting-style` / `data-ending-style` and the `--accordion-panel-height` Base UI writes.
styling.header: The title row, its button and the arrow; the trigger has `data-panel-open` while open
styling.panel: The panel (animates its height with `--accordion-panel-height`) and its padded inner layer
